ModMetaData.name: TailorMade Waistlines - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for TailorMade Waistlines, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios move the mod's sliders, which writes its settings file. Each scenario backs that file up first and restores it afterwards; if the game stops in the middle of one, the next scenario restores it before doing anything else.
Scenarios tagged @review assert nothing: they attach screenshots for a person to judge, because how a garment reads on a body drawn without legs is a judgement, not an assertion.
WDI's Realistic Bodies and AB's Visible Pants are declared as dependencies rather than as loadAfter because the captures are worthless without them: with no body retexture drawn legless there is nothing to diagnose, and with nothing filling wornGraphicPath the pawn is drawn bare. A capture taken without either would look like a passing run and show nothing.
